ladder.label: UPTREND
ladder.why: Mixed structure. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Watch the 10-day average and cycle-day count.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum positive; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum positive; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 13 · failed · daily cycle broke its start low 11d ago).
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds
⚠ Failed cycle — price broke below the low that began this cycle (11d ago)
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Prior cycle topped early (a tiring-trend hint)

entry.text: Trend intact — hold; add on dips toward the 10-day average.
entry.text_zh: 趋势完好——持有；可在回调至 10 日均线附近时加仓。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 26 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 26 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 13 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 13 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 结构混合。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 关注 10 日均线与周期天数。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量为正；投资者周期失败（跌破起始低点）；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 13 周 · 已失败 · 日线周期于 11 天前跌破其起始低点）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：上涨趋势。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
⚠ 失败周期——价格跌破了启动本周期的低点（11 天前）
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
重新站上 10 日均线之上
日线动量刚刚向上交叉
上一周期见顶偏早（趋势走弱的暗示）
ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ UPTREND signal triggered 4 trading days ago (~2026-06-12), switching from DOWNTREND. Signal strength: moderate (score +45/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 上涨趋势信号于 4 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-12），自下跌趋势切换而来。 信号强度：中等（评分 +45/100）。
ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: minimal no clean setup (+5)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：微弱无明确形态（+5）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

trust_tier.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha

headline.en: Short-duration name into a restrictive, rising-real-rate regime → rate tailwind.
headline.zh: 短久期标的进入偏紧、实际利率上行的环境→利率顺风。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta -0.04 ± 0.34 — low / noisy precision. Sector anchor (XLF) reads short-duration (-0.11). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta -0.04 ± 0.34——精度低／噪声。 板块锚（XLF）为短久期（-0.11）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。
